asserted_at.description: when the value was last asserted by the resolver (`valid_from`, defaulting to write time)

attribute_key.description: the canonical attribute this row asserts — `stage`, `employment_status`, `outcome`, `value`, `closed_date`, `project_manager` observed; 19 keys declared in all

confidence.description: the resolver's confidence in the value; 1.0 on both resolvers today

evidence.description: the raw resolver signals reconciled to produce the value, kept for auditability

financial_period.description: the financial period the assertion is scoped to when the producer knows it

legal_entity.description: the legal entity the assertion is scoped to when the producer knows it

shelf_type.description: the pattern instance `entity_attribute:{key}`; today the only carrier of the attribute identity and of the per-key supersede bucket

source_id.description: the idempotency key the writer mints (`attr:{key}:{entity_id}`)

source_system.description: the origin that asserted the value; always `DEMITON` today, because Demiton resolved it

subject_entity_id.description: the project, worker, asset or opportunity the attribute is about; the shared subject of the row

valid_until.description: the supersession stamp; the live row is `valid_until IS NULL`, and superseded values are retained as an audit trail

value.description: the resolved canonical value: the OC4IDS phase, employment state, opportunity outcome, and so on
value.x-demiton-unit: per the key (none today carries a unit)
